checks: Compressed JPEG cache enforces LRU entry limits and accounts original JPEG bytes precisely; a cache hit decodes without HTTP.
Releasing decoded images leaves no live object URLs, and clearing the cache zeroes bytes and retained entries.
Oversized JPEG remains displayable but does not enter the compressed cache.
Clearing during a pending fetch aborts it promptly and blocks late data from repopulating the cache.

environment.purpose: correctness regression, not a performance benchmark
